events.title: Tupac Shakur's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, born in 1971, was shot dead in Las Vegas on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable, a voice that still resonates deeply today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, born in 1942, died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles delivered their iconic 'Abbey Road'. That zebra crossing photo is still one of music's most recognisable images, isn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde. Still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable voice and attitude.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, was born on September 21, 1972, and turns 54 today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger to stages worldwide.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album first asked us to picture a world of peace. A timeless message that resonates as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when music went from CDs to your pocket? Twenty-five years since Apple dropped the first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to tunes.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and all the iconic moments from six decades of cinematic espionage.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British icon.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A double LP that proved their incredible range and fearless creativity.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched, a true rock legend.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showcased their evolving sound and lyrical depth.

events.title: John Lennon's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, died on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music continues to shine brightly.
